description: Generated from core/internal/settings. Values live under `settings:` in the config file; change them with `procauto settings set <key> <value>`.

^routines\\.[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*\\.builtin.description: Agent CLI built-in tools the run may use (e.g. Read, Grep, Bash, Edit), allowed explicitly. Dry runs get only the read-only ones. Defaults to `automator.builtinTools` in the routine's file.

^routines\\.[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*\\.concurr.description: queue waits for other queued runs (one at a time on this device, tightest staleness first); parallel runs alongside them. A routine never overlaps itself either way. Defaults to `automator.concurrency` in the routine's file.

^routines\\.[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*\\.effort$.description: How hard the model thinks; default leaves it to the model backend. Defaults to `automator.effort` in the routine's file.

^routines\\.[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*\\.enabled.description: Whether the routine runs on its schedule. Defaults to `automator.enabled` in the routine's file.

^routines\\.[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*\\.folder$.description: Folder the run works in (agent CLI backends), with its CLAUDE.md added to the instructions. Without one, runs work in an empty temporary folder. Defaults to `automator.folder` in the routine's file.

^routines\\.[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*\\.params\.description: A routine parameter's value (declared in its file's automator.parameters, with its type and default; required ones have no default).

^routines\\.[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*\\.schedul.description: When the routine runs (cron, local time). A routine without one runs only by hand. Defaults to `automator.schedule` in the routine's file.

^routines\\.[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*\\.session.description: save keeps the agent CLI session (in the routine's folder) and records its ID with the run, so it can be resumed; discard leaves nothing behind. Defaults to `automator.session` in the routine's file.

^routines\\.[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*\\.stalene.description: How late a missed run may still run before it's recorded as missed. Defaults to `automator.staleness` in the routine's file.

^routines\\.[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*\\.timeout.description: How long a run may take before it's stopped and recorded as failed. Defaults to `automator.timeout` in the routine's file.

history.retention-days.description: How long run history and logs are kept.

llm.backend.description: What runs routines: api = Genkit with an Anthropic API key (pay per token); claude-code = headless Claude Code on your Claude subscription.

llm.budget.weekly-usd.description: API spend allowed in the rolling 7 days (0: no limit); past it, scheduled runs don't start.

llm.budget.window.description: Length of the rolling short budget window.

llm.budget.window-usd.description: API spend allowed in the rolling short window (0: no limit); past it, scheduled runs don't start.

llm.usage-limit.description: Scheduled runs don't start while the Claude plan's 5-hour or weekly usage is above this share (they're recorded as skipped); runs started by hand still run. A run that hits the plan's limit stops scheduled runs until it resets.

memories.max-chars.description: How much each memories file may hold (every routine's, and each routine's own): what a run's prompt gets, kept small. Past it, `memory add` asks to compact first.

runs.failure-notifications.description: Notify me when a run fails, needs a sign-in, or is skipped or missed (clicking one shows the run).

update.source-dir.description: Source checkout `update` builds from when no published release has a download for this machine. Empty: the checkout this build came from.
